decisions.statement: An act invoked on a row that is no seat does nothing.
The plan is made from the state the row was drawn carrying.
A prompt is shown as a modal.
Nothing runs while a prompt is open.
Anything but the confirming answer leaves the seat untouched.
A declined act is written to the output rather than passing silently.
The fleet is read again once the act is done.
Nothing here knows the work a step does.

definition: an act taken on a seat, from the row it was invoked on to the read that follows it
